# Allowlist for leak-scan.sh: one Perl regex per line, matched against `<path>:<match>`. A match
# ends with `/` when the path goes on past the directory, and without it when the path ends there.
# Keep every entry generic or upstream-owned. Never add a real machine, user or address of ours.

# Placeholder home directories in docs, tests and examples.
:/(home|Users)/(user|u|me|you|name|someone|alice|bob|example|runner)/?$

# Homebrew's Linux prefix is a fixed path, not a person.
:/home/linuxbrew/?$

# Upstream's recorded terminal sessions and goldens carry its authors' paths; its snapshots carry
# them too, allowed by name only, so a snapshot regenerated on another machine still fails.
:/home/(aram|thomas|jinho)/?$
^src/tests/fixtures/
^zellij-terminal/fixtures/goldens/

# Sample addresses already in tests, each pinned to its file.
^default-plugins/session-manager/src/main\.rs:10\.0\.0\.7$
^zellij-utils/src/desktop_integration/platform\.rs:10\.0\.0\.[12]$
^zellij-utils/src/input/cli_assets\.rs:192\.168\.1\.[25]$
^zellij-utils/src/plugin_api/event\.rs:192\.168\.1\.5$

# Upstream's desktop-entry test quotes a path with a space in it.
^zellij-utils/src/desktop_integration/desktop_entry\.rs:/(?:home)/a$
